body.statement: If the universal legal-lifting property in Open-ended Question 1 holds, then every nonempty \(\Theta_\delta(\mathcal P,q)\) is a compact semialgebraic subset of \([h_-,h_+]\), hence a finite union of closed intervals and points; \(\ell\) and \(u\) are attained algebraic numbers and admit finite response-SCM witnesses. With \(H_{\max}=2^N-1\), source support bounded by \(K_{\max}=m+3\), parameter count \(p_{\mathrm{dim}}=O(H_{\max}K_{\max})\), constraint count \(s_{\mathrm{count}}=O(m+H_{\max}K_{\max}+N^3)\), degree \(D_{\mathrm{deg}}=O(H_{\max}+N)\), and expanded coefficient bit length \(\tau_{\mathrm{eff}}\), cylindrical algebraic decomposition gives the per-architecture factor \((s_{\mathrm{count}}D_{\mathrm{deg}})^{2^{O(p_{\mathrm{dim}})}}\operatorname{poly}(\tau_{\mathrm{eff}})\) in the certified procedure.
body.justification: Compactness converts the algebraic compiler into sharp, attained causal conclusions and explicit certificates.
body.gap: Rosset, Gisin, and Wolfe derive closed semialgebraic correlation sets after cardinality reduction, but exact selected-MAG inequalities and shared selection normalization are absent.
body.consumer: Attained algebraic witnesses allow auditors to display concrete best- and worst-case mechanisms rather than numerical optimizer traces.
